actionPreparationNotes: Save is Blink-backed. Treat it similarly to Lulo until a first-class adapter lands. Require asset, amount, and action URL before preparing writes.
riskNotes: Surface APY, liquidity, and withdrawal constraints when available. Do not describe yield as guaranteed.
walletApprovalBoundary: Save actions are approval-bound. The agent prepares a review item only; the wallet signs separately.
